overview_description.description: Lumio Holdings is a concept lab dedicated to disrupting multiple sectors. Their ventures include Kwelio, a health supplement brand that integrates technology and gamification, and Kwelio Labs, which focuses on developing digital platforms and automation solutions. Additionally, Lumio Holdings plans to launch Kwelio HealthTech, a healthcare technology initiative aimed at enhancing health solutions through technology.
